import numpy as np
import struct
import base64

def save_wav(filename, data, rate=44100):
    with open(filename, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(b'RIFF')
        f.write(struct.pack('<I', 36 + len(data)))
        f.write(b'WAVE')
        f.write(b'fmt ')
        f.write(struct.pack('<I', 16))
        f.write(struct.pack('<H', 3))  # float32
        f.write(struct.pack('<H', 1))  # mono
        f.write(struct.pack('<I', rate))
        f.write(struct.pack('<I', rate * 4))
        f.write(struct.pack('<H', 4))
        f.write(struct.pack('<H', 32))
        f.write(b'data')
        f.write(struct.pack('<I', len(data)))
        f.write(data)

# Generate samples
sr = 44100

# Saw wave at 110 Hz (A2) - bass
dur = 0.4
t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr * dur), False)
saw = 2 * (np.arange(len(t)) / (sr / 110) % 1) - 1
saw = saw.astype(np.float32)
saw = saw / np.max(np.abs(saw)) * 0.8
save_wav('/tmp/bass.wav', saw.tobytes(), sr)

# Sine at 440 Hz (A4) - lead
t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr * dur), False)
sin = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 440 * t).astype(np.float32)
sin = sin / np.max(np.abs(sin)) * 0.7
save_wav('/tmp/lead.wav', sin.tobytes(), sr)

# Square at 220 Hz (A3) - arp
t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr * dur), False)
square = np.sign(np.sin(2 * np.pi * 220 * t)).astype(np.float32)
square = square / np.max(np.abs(square)) * 0.6
save_wav('/tmp/arp.wav', square.tobytes(), sr)

# Hi-hat (noise)
noise = (np.random.rand(int(sr * 0.1)) * 2 - 1).astype(np.float32)
noise = noise / np.max(np.abs(noise)) * 0.4
save_wav('/tmp/hh.wav', noise.tobytes(), sr)

print("WAV files created.")
EOF"}
